phase4.optimizer: AdamW, fused CUDA, fixed warmup/cosine schedule
phase4.precision: BF16 CUDA autocast; FP32 parameters/loss accounting
phase4.selection: minimum validation BPT among the four registered checkpoints; test never selects
phase4.budget_interpretation: fixed-compute instrument; report effective corpus epochs and continuing validation improvement; no convergence claim
phase4.position_events: known SOL / previous EOL / explicit paragraph start before target; never future EOL

phase5.classifier_grouping: leave one source-word block index out across all corpora, keeping clean/noise and C1 derivatives together
phase5.equivalence_bands: empirical ZL/LSI-H difference in each matching metric, widened by pooled model seed SD for position gain; not a formal equivalence test
phase5.surprise_model_selection: lowest mean validation bits/nonspace source character across all architectures/tokenizations/position variants, with explicit OOV literal escape cost (32-bit UTF-8 byte length plus bytes); test data never selects model
phase5.surprise_cv: all manuscript leaf sides/panels stay in a single fold; refit vocabulary and control BPE within training fold; held-out labels never train the running model
phase5.probes: single-line baseline-model representations, no metadata inputs; section and Currier plus independent fake-label floors on controls; hand and paragraph start ZL only
phase5.geometry_stem_rule: longest common prefix >=3 and >= half the shorter word; descriptive string family, not linguistic morphology
